parsed_json.up: Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human Aromatase (CHEMBL1978) that have both a canonical SMILES and a PubMed ID or DOI. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays and target_dictionary, filtering by target chembl_id CHEMBL1978 and standard_type IC50. Require an INNER JOIN to compound_structures to ensure canonical_smiles is present. Use the provenance path through compound_records to docs to retrieve pubmed_id and doi, preferring pubmed_id when available. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
